name: AR_CUSTOMER_ALT_NAMES
description: The AR_CUSTOMER_ALT_NAMES table contains alternate customer names that are often used by Japanese business. The records in this table are used for Lockbox name matching. When bank files in the Japanese Zengin format are imported, customers must match Zengin receipts with customer information before the records can be validated and posted. When Zengin receipts are matched with customer information the AR_CUSTOMER_ALT_NAMES table is updated. The next time Lockbox runs, Oracle Receivables can automatically match unidentified receipts to these customers. The primary key for this table is ALT_NAME_ID.

columns.name: ALT_NAME
columns.description: Alternate customer name using Zengin characters.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill-to location identifier for the customer

columns.name: VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Virtual account number assigned to the customer account or site and provided in the Zengin Lockbox file.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_BANK_BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Remittance bank branch number of the customer

columns.name: REMITTANCE_BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank number of the remittance bank that issues the virtual account number.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ZENGIN_BANK_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the customer bank name from the Zengin Format file.

columns.name: ZENGIN_BANK_BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the customer bank branch name from the Zengin Format file.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the alternate name mapping rule is active or inactive.
